browserSourcePatches.note: Floe local frontend patch, not an upstream commit. A batched two-finger touchstart initializes the shared start/target from the first touch before entering the existing multi-touch path; retained positions from a completed gesture are discarded for the next batched birth, and touchcancel clears multiTouch.

Chained after ios-batched-touch-start.patch on the same file. onTouchCancel propagates the cancelled two-finger gesture to the current target before clearing the position/target state, so ZoomControl can close its live zoom-frame in the same gesture without committing a zoom. The native Pencil/palm gate is untouched.

Floe local frontend patch, not an upstream commit. Every two-finger move paints the existing zoom-frame at the range-clamped, unrounded target scale before the gesture ends. The end commit is synchronous in the same gesture and takes the nearest integer level to the range-clamped finger zoom (rounding step at most half a level), keeping the zoomTo guard/hook set (OverviewFade, _limitZoom, spreadsheet closePopups); the historical outward ceil/floor value is retained only as the beyond-range Overview guard input. touchcancel closes the frame at the start zoom without a commit.
